create_bert_encoder: create a BertEncoder instance with a pretrained BERT model path and custom dropout rate
run_bert_encoder_forward: run the BertEncoder forward pass with tokenized input to get sentence representations
build_bert_config: build a BertConfig from a pretrained model path with custom dropout probabilities
test_bert_encoder: test the BertEncoder class by encoding tokenized text and extracting CLS token representations
review_bert_encoder_forward: review the BertEncoder forward method to understand how it extracts sentence embeddings from BERT
